description: NIRC2 is the near-infrared adaptive-optics camera on Keck II, with filters from about 1 to 5 microns. The bands kept here are the broad filters J, H, K, Ks, Kp, Lp and Ms.
short_description: Keck II NIRC2 adaptive-optics near-infrared camera filters
facility_description: NIRC2 sits behind the adaptive-optics bench on the left Nasmyth platform of the Keck II telescope at W. M. Keck Observatory.
notes: Central wavelengths, bandpass widths, cut-on and cut-off wavelengths, and the Strehl=1 zeropoints are transcribed from the NIRC2 filter table. Bandpass width is defined there as the wavelength range where transmission exceeds 50 percent of peak. The same page says broad-band specifications are room-temperature measurements from the manufacturer, while narrow-band values were measured cold in NIRC2; J, H, K, Ks, Kp, Lp and Ms are in the broad-band section. Zeropoints are defined with counts per second and a Strehl term. The page states a gain of 4.0 electrons per count. The general-specifications page says that value was for the transputer electronics, and that the gain is 8 e-/DN after science operations with the Archon controller began on 20 November 2023. Neither page names Vega or AB, so MagSys is not set, and neither says whether the transmissions are photon-weighted or energy-weighted. The NIRC2 home page says No Publication Reference. The author page lists NIRC2 with no paper link. No SPIE or PASP instrument paper that publishes these passbands was opened, so no reference key is stored. Liu et al. 2012 is linked from the filter page for Y-band conversions; Y is not one of these bands and that paper was not opened. The Keck author-page acknowledgement is for papers based on Keck data. The Maunakea sentence there is only suggested and is omitted. KOA's access page requests an archive acknowledgement when KOA is used and describes proprietary periods; it does not licence the filter-curve spreadsheet. https://www2.keck.hawaii.edu/gallery/copyright.php returned 404. The include_end.js footer does not clearly allow redistribution of the curves, so the licence class is restricted.

H.Description: Broad H filter in the NIRC2 filter wheel.
H.Comments: The filter table lists a central wavelength of 1.633 μm and a bandpass width of 0.296 μm, with cut-on 1.485 μm and cut-off 1.781 μm. The tabulated photometric zeropoint is 25.44 for Strehl of 1. Broad-band specifications are room-temperature manufacturer measurements.
